# CONSTRUCTED — not captures. The two shapes that turn a link into a WRONG slug:
#   the marketing site is not a board, and must yield nothing
<a href="https://www.greenhouse.io/customers">Powered by Greenhouse</a>
#   the script-tag include, where the slug is in ?for= and the path segment is
#   the literal "embed" — must yield examplecorp, never embed
<script src="https://boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_board/js?for=examplecorp"></script>
